description: Use this tool when a user wants to estimate the cost of a long distance household move between two US states with Cross Country Movers: interstate moving, cross-country moving, moving a 1-4 bedroom home or studio to another state. Inputs: origin and destination (city + state or ZIP), home size (studio, 1-4 bedrooms) or cubic feet, optional first available date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the route, driving miles, an estimated price range (low end first) from our own booked moves on that route and size, the number of booked moves behind it, the delivery window and a 'Get your exact price' link (rooms, video or inventory). Routes with fewer than 3 booked moves return no number and a callback offer. Estimates only, not binding; nothing is booked. Do not use for local moves within one state, car shipping (use get_quote) or moves outside the US (use get_international_quote).
name: get_long_distance_quote
title: Get long distance moving quote
